t: Fast-drying formulation. Gypsum based, ready mixed product designed for jointing plasterboards when drylining and and for levelling wall irregularities. Easy to sand in preparation for decorating. Can fill up to 5mm deep in one application. White colour of plaster ensures a lower number of coats while painting. Can be stored and reused at a later date (see use by date).
b: Quick Drying: More Coats in a Shorter Time Period
